payload.score_comment_short: Your account portfolio and review cadence are specific, but results remain unclear.
payload.score_comment_long: The current role names a B2B SaaS portfolio, its recurring revenue, and regular customer reviews. It doesn't say what followed from the renewal-risk reviews or business reviews. Adding those details would make the work easier to assess.
payload.score_plain: The resume gives a reviewer a clear reason to consider your customer success background. More detail about your renewal work would help them compare it with the needs of a particular role.
payload.first_impression: Your current role centers on customer relationships and renewals for a defined SaaS portfolio. The objective and soft-skill statements take up space without explaining what you do differently.
payload.biggest_gap_example: "Introduced monthly renewal-risk reviews across the portfolio" doesn't explain how you assessed risk or what happened after a review, leaving the value of that process unclear.
payload.summary: Managing 32 B2B SaaS accounts with $2.4M in annual recurring revenue gives your customer success work a useful commercial context. Your progression from account coordination to Customer Success Manager points to experience at the manager level, without establishing people-management responsibility. The resume also shows a regular rhythm of renewal-risk and customer leadership reviews. It doesn't yet show what decisions or follow-up came out of those conversations, which makes the work harder to compare with a target role.
strengths: The portfolio's account count and annual recurring revenue make the size of your customer book concrete.
Quarterly business reviews with customer leadership teams show the audience you worked with, not just a general communication claim.
Weekly shipment status reports establish a specific client-facing responsibility in your earlier logistics role.
gaps: The objective doesn't name a role or connect your background to the work you want next.
The resume doesn't explain the topics or follow-up from business reviews, so their practical use remains unclear.
The account coordinator entry doesn't identify which tasks you assisted account managers with, leaving your contribution broad.

top_fixes.fix: In the renewal-risk review bullet, explain how you identified at-risk accounts and what follow-up you personally handled.
top_fixes.why: That would show how the monthly review informed your renewal work.
